blog.title: Guides
blog.description: Scenario playbooks for authorized labs — pick a path, load a preset, adapt LHOST/LPORT.
blog.intro: Short guides and release notes for lab workflows. All generation still runs locally in your browser.
blog.scenarios_subtitle: Start from a real engagement pattern, not a changelog.

web.title: Web RCE → callback
web.body: Use Python, PHP, or Node one-liners when you have command execution but limited tooling. Prefer URL-encoded variants behind WAFs.

linux.title: Linux TCP callback
linux.body: Bash /dev/tcp, netcat mkfifo, or socat when outbound TCP is open. Match architecture and available binaries on target.

windows.title: Windows callback
windows.body: PowerShell and cmd techniques with optional encoding. Confirm execution policy and AMSI context in your lab.

tls.title: TLS / SSL egress
tls.body: When only encrypted outbound traffic is allowed, use OpenSSL, ncat SSL, or TLS-wrapped callbacks.

bind.title: Bind shell labs
bind.body: Inbound connections when reverse egress is blocked. Set bind port and ensure firewall rules in the lab.

staged.title: Staged HTTP delivery
staged.body: curl/wget loaders and second-stage scripts for segmented networks. Host the stage on your HTTP server.

welcome.title: Welcome to reverseshell
welcome.excerpt: How to use the builder, listener, and engagement card export in authorized labs.
welcome.body: Open the builder to pick a template, set LHOST/LPORT, and copy or export commands. Use collections for presets, and the engagement card export to capture configuration and notes in markdown.

builder-update.title: Builder persistence and shareable URLs
builder-update.excerpt: Your last builder config is saved locally; share lab setups with query parameters.
builder-update.body: The builder restores your last template, LHOST, LPORT, and obfuscation from localStorage. Valid configs also sync to the URL so you can bookmark or share a lab setup. A recommended listener card appears beside the generated command, and the payload picker supports search across the expanded catalog.
